title: Ghazi University Dera Ghazi Khan Amendment Ordinance 2015

sections.shortTitle: Ghazi University Dera Ghazi Khan Amendment Ordinance 2015
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIV OF 2015
ORDINANCE XIV OF 2015
GHAZI
UNIVERSITY, DERA GHAZI KHAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2015
An Ordinance further to amend the Ghazi University,
Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2012
[Gazette
of Punjab Extraordinary 12th May, 2015]
No. Legis:
13-46/2011, dated 12-5-2015.---The following Ordinance
promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information:
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act 2012
(XXIX of 2012) for purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the Punjab is satisfied that
circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make and
promulgate the following Ordinance:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Ordinance may be cited as the Ghazi University, Dera
Ghazi Khan (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

ORDINANCE XIV OF 2015

UNIVERSITY, DERA GHAZI KHAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2015
An Ordinance further to amend the Ghazi University,
Dera Ghazi Khan Act, 2012
[Gazette
of Punjab Extraordinary 12th May, 2015]
No. Legis:
13-46/2011, dated 12-5-2015.---The following Ordinance
promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information:
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Ghazi University, Dera Ghazi Khan Act 2012
(XXIX of 2012) for purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the Punjab is satisfied that
circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make and
promulgate the following Ordinance:
3. Amendment in section 21 of Act XXIX of
2012.---In the said Act, in section 21, in subsection (1):
(a) in
clause (iv), after the word affiliated colleges , the words including at
least one female Principal shall be inserted;
(b) in
clause (vi), after the word lecturer the words out of whom at least three
shall be women shall be inserted;
(c) in
clause (vii), after the word persons , the words including at least one
woman shall be inserted; and
(d) in
clause (ix), after the word experts , the words including at least two female
experts shall be inserted.
